edges.subject: CLN7
edges.quote: a homozygous frameshift mutation in the CLN7 gene (CLN7-/-) caused neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis, commonly known as Batten Disease

edges.subject: neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis
edges.quote: Affected macaques display progressive neurological deficits including visual impairment, tremor, incoordination, ataxia and impaired balance.

edges.subject: neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis
edges.quote: CLN7-/- macaques have reduced retinal thickness and retinal function early in disease, followed by profound cerebral and cerebellar atrophy that progresses over a five to six-year disease course.
